title: The inverse-first-power universal integral-means spectrum
exact_target: For injective holomorphic maps f from the unit disk into the unit disk, let $\beta _f(-1)=\limsup _{r->1}$ $\log (integral_0^{2\pi }$ |f'(r exp(i $\theta ))|^{-1}$ dtheta)/log(1/(1-r)), and let $B_b(-1)$ be the supremum of $\beta _f(-1)$ over that class. Is $B_b(-1)=1/4$?
